preconditions.description: Number of vertices n is between 1 and 100.
Number of edges m is between 0 and n(n-1)/2.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and x != y for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the range [1, n].

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'FHTAGN!' if is_cthulhu(n, edges) else return_value == 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output is 'FHTAGN!' if the graph is Cthulhu, otherwise 'NO'.
